experiences.name: Massage Therapy
experiences.description: Registered massage therapists come to your property for a private session. Choose from deep tissue, relaxation, hot stone, or couples massage.

experiences.name: Private Yoga
experiences.description: Certified instructors for sunrise flows, sunset sessions, or afternoon restorative yoga. Indoors or outdoors — dockside, in the garden, or your living room.

experiences.name: Private Chef
experiences.description: A professional chef prepares a locally sourced, custom meal in your property's kitchen. From intimate dinners for two to celebrations for 16, every dish tells a story.

experiences.name: Wine & Charcuterie
experiences.description: Curated regional wine selections paired with artisan cheese and charcuterie boards, sourced from local Ontario producers. Ready on arrival or at your chosen time.

experiences.name: Fitness & Personal Training
experiences.description: A certified personal trainer delivers a custom session at your property — HIIT, strength, stretch, or outdoor bootcamp. No gym required.

experiences.name: Sound Bath & Meditation
experiences.description: A guided sound healing session using crystal bowls and instruments. Perfect for groups, couples, or solo retreat experiences in your own serene space.

experiences.name: Grocery Pre-Stock
experiences.description: Send us your list, we shop local. Your fridge and pantry are stocked with fresh, quality groceries before you arrive — so your vacation starts the moment you walk in.

experiences.name: Welcome Arrangements
experiences.description: Custom floral arrangements, curated welcome baskets, and occasion setups for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, and baby showers — all styled and in place on arrival.
